title: geotruth case v2
description: One corpus case: two typed operands with metadata. Cases are immutable; expected answers are versioned separately. One JSON object per line in corpus/cases/*.jsonl.

id.description: Case id, unique within the corpus (e.g. "near-collinear-000123").

family.description: Generator family (families starting with "invalid-" deliberately contain invalid inputs).

ops.description: Operations to run; absent means every supported operation except echo. The parse-echo canary is a case with ops ["echo"].

Tags.description: Stratification tags; results are reported per class. Extra keys are allowed.

degeneracy.description: lattice: exactly representable degeneracy (touch, collinear overlap); ulp: within a few ulps of one; generic: neither.

n.description: Total number of input vertices of a and b.

k.description: Number of intersection points between a and b, if known.

flags.description: Free-form kebab-case flags, e.g. convention (the answer depends on the empty-geometry convention table), zero-length-line, nonfinite, empty, invalid-input.

Provenance.description: Where the case came from (generator + seed, or the upstream issue of a curated case). Extra keys are allowed.

parent.description: Id of the case this one was minimised or derived from.
